audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was marked 'Skill' although whys[4] and spikes[1] both say Kennen flatly answers the hook all-in there, and the two-item row was given to Kennen although whys[6] and spikes[3] say a fed MR tank survives the ult and picks Kennen.
audit.why: 50.95% over 842 games is an even lane whose stages swing: Kennen owns the ult window, Nautilus owns the late game once he buys MR. The packet chart agrees on both rows.
audit.corrected: L1 Skill, L2-L3 Kennen, Levels 4-5 Skill, L6 Kennen, first item Kennen, 2+ items Nautilus. Proposed as matched pairs across both layers.

audit.why: Spike placement holds: Kennen at 2-3 and at 6, first item burst, Nautilus late. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s while Depth Charge is 120/100/80, so Nautilus out-cycles the ult trade from rank 2 — which is why the late row flips to him.
audit.corrected: Spike timings kept; only spikes[1] text was tightened to name the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent: Dredge Line out-ranges Kennen's poke (1150 vs 950) on a 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown; Titan's Wrath (flat 12s) is a shield that eats the burst window; and Kennen has no dash, so Dredge Line's terrain pull can cut a retreat Lightning Rush cannot answer.
audit.why: Kennen Q range 950; Nautilus Q range 1150 with terrain and knockup flags; Nautilus W is a shield on a flat 12s. Kennen's E is a movement-speed form that passes through units, not a dash. Both missingInteractions rules (shield-absorbs-burst, terrain-cuts-retreat) point at the same gap.
audit.corrected: Bait Titan's Wrath before committing the stun chain, hold Flash for the hook rather than for damage, and stop treating 950 as a safe distance from his engage.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Nautilus carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A tank with MR survives your R, and Q-hook into point-blank Depth Charge is a free pick — group instead of sidelaning.

edits.before: His only engage is Q (Dredge Line) and you both poke softly level 1 — last-hit at range and dont give him a hook angle.
edits.after: Dredge Line reaches 1150, further than your 950, but it is his only engage at 14s — last-hit behind minions, give no hook angle.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom plus your three-mark stun answers his all-in: if he Q-hooks in, R stun-locks him before his E-AoE and R knockup can chain you.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom plus your three-mark stun answers his all-in: bait Titan's Wrath (flat 12s) out first, then R him before E and his R knockup chain.

edits.before: Poke his health bar down with Q from max range so a single Q-hook never sets up a kill
edits.after: Poke from max range and save Flash for his hook — you have no dash, and E is not one

edits.before: Hit level 6 and hold R to punish his hook engage instead of getting chain-CCd by Q-E-R
edits.after: Bait Titan's Wrath (12s) out, then hold R to punish his hook instead of eating Q-E-R

notes: No name defects in this matchup — packet suspectNames was empty and every ability name in the current text checks out against the kit. Whether Lightning Rush's unit-passthrough lets Kennen cross the terrain Dredge Line pulls him against is not answerable from the kits, so no claim was made either way.
